blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Long-horizon tasks require preserving and later recovering cross-session evidence under a bounded, query-blind memory budget. Existing compression can discard fine-grained visual cues or conflate semantically similar but incompatible observations. We present C3M , a cross-session multimodal memory organization that maintains a bounded active index over persistent source text-image evidence. Relation-aware updates consolidate safe redundancy while preserving complementary and incompatible records. At query time, budgeted routing selects useful index pages and expands their associated source evidence under a fixed reader budget. Together, these mechanisms establish a compact, provenance-preserving multimodal memory organization for cross-session long-horizon tasks, retaining temporal distinctions and source links required for reliable downstream reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/HuzhouNLP/C3M .
blocks.zh: 长视距任务需要保存并随后在有界限的,无查询的内存预算下收回跨会证. 现有的压缩可以丢弃精致的视觉提示,或者将类似但互不兼容的观测集合. 我们提出C3M, 一个跨会场的多模式记忆组织, 相对于源持久文本图像证据, 了解关系更新可加强安全冗余,同时保留互补和不兼容的记录。 在查询时间,编入预算的路由选择有用的索引页,并在固定的阅读器预算下扩展其相关的源证据. 这些机制共同建立了一个紧凑的、保留来源的多式联运记忆组织,用于跨会场长距离任务,保留时间区分和可靠下游推理所需的源链接。 代码见https://github.com/HuzhouNLP/C3M。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Long-horizon tasks require agents to preserve information across interactions [ 3 , 10 , 2 ] ,
because later requests may depend on earlier observations, changed states, or
evidence whose relevance becomes apparent only retrospectively [ 15 , 4 , 20 ] .
This has motivated persistent memory systems that
store, update, organize, and retrieve accumulated experience across time [ 21 , 14 , 9 , 17 ] . The challenge becomes harder in cross-session multimodal
settings, where relevant evidence may be distributed across text and images, and
fine-grained visual details can determine future answers. Memory must therefore
remain compact while keeping earlier source evidence recoverable when summaries
are insufficient.

因为以后的请求可能取决于先前的观测结果、更改的状态或
其相关性仅在追溯性[15、4、20]时才明显。
这激发了持续的记忆系统
存储、更新、组织和检索跨时间积累的经验[21、14、9、17]。 跨会期多式联运的挑战变得更加困难
设置,其中相关证据可在文本和图像之间分发,以及
精细的视觉细节可以决定未来的答案. 因此,记忆必须
保持紧凑,同时保持早期源证据在摘要时可收回
这还不够。

blocks.en:
The central challenge is maintaining a bounded, query-blind state without collapsing distinctions that future queries may require .
Observations can be redundant or complementary, while records similar in text or appearance may
differ in entity, state, or time.
Aggressive merging can erase differences visible
only in joint text-image context; retaining every near-duplicate instead consumes capacity and weakens routing selectivity. Compact entries must therefore preserve
provenance, distinguish stable facts from later states, and recover source images when summaries are insufficient.
These requirements are especially important
across sessions: interruptions, partial observability, and delayed feedback make
forgotten or conflated state difficult to reconstruct, while irreversible actions
amplify the cost of errors [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh:
中心挑战是保持一个有限度的、无查询状态,而不破坏未来查询可能需要的区别。
意见可能是多余的或补充的,而文本或外观类似的记录可能
实体、状态或时间各不相同。
主动合并可以消除可见的差异

来源,区分稳定的事实与后来的状态,并在摘要不充分时恢复源图像.
这些要求特别重要
中断、部分可观察性和延迟反馈
被遗忘或合并的状态难以重建,而不可逆转的行动
扩大错误成本[3].

blocks.en:
Existing multimodal memory systems address parts of this problem through
visual-token compression and sparse memory, fixed-budget
updates, and gist or context distillation [ 13 , 12 , 7 , 19 ] .
Content-aware and conflict-aware [ 6 , 8 ] approaches improve retention, but similarity alone does not imply safe merging. Compression may discard visual cues,
text-image bindings, source images, or temporal versions, while routing remains constrained by fixed reader budgets.
Memory benefits also vary, reflecting trade-offs among compactness, information preservation, and utility [ 1 , 16 ] .
Multimodal long-context reasoning is further challenged by image-text distractors, compression-induced loss of visual fidelity, and modality-relevance gaps [ 18 , 11 , 5 ] .

视觉磁盘压缩和少量内存,固定预算
最新数据,以及重点或上下文蒸馏[13、12、7、19]。
内容意识和冲突意识[6,8]方法改进了保留,但仅靠相似性并不意味着安全的合并。 压缩可能会丢掉视觉提示,
文本图像绑定,源图像,或时间版本,而路由仍然受到固定读者预算的限制.
记忆效益也各不相同,反映了紧凑性、信息保存和效用[1、16]之间的权衡。
多式联运长文本推理受到图像文本分散功能、压缩导致的视觉忠贞性丧失和模式相关性差距[18、11、5]的进一步挑战。

multimodal memory organization that maintains a bounded active index over persistent source text-image evidence, preserves necessary distinctions during
maintenance, and expands source evidence from selected pages under a fixed reader budget.

blocks.en: 3 Experiment
blocks.zh: 3 实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate MemLens’s official 195-question agent subset (789 total)
at 32K/64K/128K histories [ 11 ] .
Tasks cover information extraction (IE), multi-session reasoning (MSR),
temporal reasoning (TR), knowledge update (KU), and answer refusal (AR),
potentially combining visual details with textual context across sessions.
blocks.zh:
我们评价MemLens的官方195问题代理子集(共计789个)
在32K/64K/128K历史 [11].
任务包括信息提取(IE),多会推理(MSR),
时间推理(TR)、知识更新(KU)、回答拒绝(AR)、
有可能将视觉细节与整个届会的文字背景结合起来。

blocks.en:
Unlike offline full-history evaluation, chronological replay retains original
questions and interleaved text-image evidence. Updates access only incoming
sessions and memory; future sessions, query, gold answer, and question type are
hidden. Query-blind consolidation and forgetting precede budgeted retrieval
after the final session.

问题和相互间文本图像证据。 只更新已接收到的访问
会话和内存; 未来的会话、 查询、 金答案和提问类型为
藏起来 查询- 盲合并和在预算检索之前忘记

blocks.en: 3.2 Baselines and Fair Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.2 基线和公平议定书

blocks.en:
Baselines retain their policies over shared Raw Nodes and provenance:
text-based ReSum summarizes older blocks, retaining recent nodes [ 19 ] ; video-based MovieChat merges temporally adjacent entries
in short-/long-term buffers [ 13 ] ; text-based MemRefine applies
LLM-guided Delete / Merge / Preserve to globally similar pairs [ 6 ] ; embodied-memory CDRs uses an independent graph with
query-local conflict detection [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh:
基线保留其对共享原始节点和来源的政策:
基于文本的 ReSum 总结了较旧的块, 保留最近的节点 [19]; 基于视频的电影 聊天合并暂时相邻条目
中短期/长期缓冲[13];基于文本的MemRefine适用
LLM 制导 删除 / 合并 / 保存到全球相似的对 [6] ; 内含的 CDR 使用独立的图
查询 - 局部冲突检测 [8] 。

blocks.en:
Shared limits cover the active store (36 entries, six
pages, 6,144 index tokens, 384 KiB), and reader limits (page beam 3, 12 Raw Nodes,
eight images, 12K text tokens). Answerers match per model; one judge is shared. CDRs’s graph bytes and pre-filter candidates count toward the
same budgets. Raw Nodes and embeddings are shared; only maintenance and routing differ.
This controls evidence availability when comparing how methods organize and retrieve memory.

共享限制覆盖活动商店(36个条目,6个)
页面,6,144个索引符号,384个KiB)和读者限制(页束3,12个Raw节点,
8个图像,12K文本符号). 回答者匹配每个模型;共享一个裁判. CDRs的图字节和预过滤候选人数

这在比较方法组织和检索内存时控制了证据的可用性.

blocks.en: 4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4 读物研究

blocks.en: 4.1 Cross-Session Context Pressure
blocks.zh: 4.1 跨会议背景压力

blocks.en:
Longer cross-session histories increase active-index pressure. We conduct this diagnostic on a fixed, coverage-balanced subset of 34 questions
spanning all five MemLens abilities. All conditions use the same query-blind
writer, fixed C1 (24-entry) active-index budget, and reader allocation.
Fig. 3 shows that, as history grows from 32K to 128K,
active-index utilization reaches saturation while Route-Hit, Support Recall,
and Answer Accuracy decline. The accompanying resource audit reports a
corresponding increase in overflow repairs, from 0.00 to 21.44 per episode,
while the reader allocation remains unchanged. Raw-Node pointers increase
with the source history (64.79, 126.97, and 239.32 per episode) and match the
number of input Raw Nodes, indicating that the active-index constraint limits
routing organization rather than deleting the underlying source text-image
evidence.

blocks.en: 4.2 Active-Index Budget Scaling
blocks.zh: 4.2 现行强化预算

blocks.en:
Active-index expansion reduces maintenance pressure but does not
guarantee monotonic task gains. At a fixed 128K cross-session history length, we proportionally scale the
entry capacity, per-page capacity, routing-text allowance, and index-byte
allowance, while holding the reader budget and persistent Raw-Node pointers
constant. Fig. 3 shows that expanding the active index
steadily reduces overflow repairs, from 33.38 to 3.38 per episode. In
contrast, Route-Hit, Support Recall, and Answer Accuracy vary non-monotonically
and peak at different scales: Route-Hit is highest at C1.75, whereas Overall
accuracy peaks at C1.25 and C1.5. Thus, additional capacity alleviates
structural index pressure but cannot replace selective index organization and
query-time evidence routing.

保证单调任务增益。 在固定的128K跨会历史长度上,我们按比例衡量
输入能力、每页容量、路由文本备抵和索引字节
备忘,同时持有阅读预算和持续Raw-Node指针
不变。 费格。 3 显示正在扩展的指数
持续减少超时修理,每集从33.38次减少到3.38次。 内
反之,Route-Hit、Support Recall和Answer精确度在非元数据上有所不同
和不同尺度的峰值: 路线-Hit最高,为C1.75,而总的来说

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We proposed a multimodal memory organization for cross-session long-horizon tasks.
It maintains memory under a fixed active-index budget without access to future
queries, coupling a bounded active index with persistently addressable source
text-image evidence:
relation-aware maintenance preserves distinctions among redundant, evolving, and
incompatible observations, while budgeted evidence routing connects compact index
entries to the original text and images through provenance-preserving pointers.
Experiments under our online, session-by-session evaluation protocol across
different cross-session histories show that C3M performs better overall than other
memory compression methods under shared index and reader budgets. C3M integrates
source evidence preservation, relation-aware updates, and budgeted retrieval
for cross-session multimodal memory maintenance in long-horizon tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们提议建立一个跨会长视野任务的多式联运记忆组织。
它在固定的活性指数预算下维持内存,无法进入未来
查询,将一个有界限的有效索引与持续可地址源合并
文本图像证据 :
了解关系的维护在冗余、不断发展和
不兼容的观察,而编入预算的证据路径连接紧凑索引
通过保留来源的指针,输入原始文本和图像。
我们的在线、逐届会议评价协议下的实验
不同的跨会历史表明,C3M的总体表现优于其他
共享索引和阅读器预算下的内存压缩方法. C3M集成系统
来源证据保存、了解关系的最新情况和预算检索
用于长视距任务中的跨会场多模式内存维护.
